newsitem.title: KENYA: Coffee prices seen firmer at Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: Coffee prices seen firmer at Kenyan auction.

text.p: Coffee prices were seen firmer at Kenya's weekly export auction which resumed on Tuesday after a two week break, traders said.
A senior official from the Kenya Coffee Auctions Ltd said grade ABs averaged $145 per 50 kg bag from $130, AAs rose to $149 from $146 and Cs rose to $142 from $129.
"Following a two week break in the auction, prices advanced in line with the stronger world market," the auctions official told Reuters.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 41,000 60-kg bags it offered for sale compared to 34,045 sold two weeks ago.
